# Buy A Warranty (buyawarranty.co.uk)

> UK vehicle warranty provider. Instant online quotes for car, van, motorbike
> and EV warranties, with claims handled in-house. Editorial guides for UK
> drivers are published on The Warranty Hub. Content is human-authored,
> UK-specific (GBP, UK law, DVSA/MOT rules) and regularly updated.
> All pages are open to AI crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot,
> Google-Extended, PerplexityBot, Applebot-Extended, CCBot) and may be cited
> with a link back to the source URL.

## Core pages

- [Home — car warranty quotes](https://buyawarranty.co.uk/): Enter a registration to get an instant UK warranty quote.
- [What's covered](https://buyawarranty.co.uk/whats-covered): Components, claim limits, labour rates and exclusions.
- [Make a claim](https://buyawarranty.co.uk/make-a-claim): How the claims process works and what documents are needed.
- [FAQs](https://buyawarranty.co.uk/faqs): Common questions on eligibility, waiting periods and cancellations.
- [Contact us](https://buyawarranty.co.uk/contact-us): Phone, email and opening hours.
